# CANDIDATE: VIX_RSI_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-09-07
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bearish divergence between VIX (higher high) and SPY RSI (lower high) foreshadows a short‑term reversal after a bearish engulfing candle at resistance.

## Mechanism

Detect VIX making a higher high than VIX five periods ago while SPY RSI(14) makes a lower high than RSI five periods ago. Identify the nearest prior swing high (named level or recent HH). Wait for a bearish engulfing candle (close < open, body > prior candle body) that closes below the midpoint of the prior candle. Enter short at the close of that engulfing candle. Exit shape: Stop above the high of the engulfing candle; target 1.5×R. If price reaches 1×R, move stop to break‑even and then trail with ATR×2. Regime hint: VIX > 20 (elevated), time 10:00‑14:00, and price below VWAP to align with bearish bias.
